scripts.dev:prepare: sh -c 'fuser -k 3001/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; fuser -k 5173/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; fuser -k 5174/tcp 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm --prefix client run dev" "dotnet watch --project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj run --urls http://127.0.0.1:3001"
scripts.build: dotnet build server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.db:migration:add: sh -c 'if [ -z "$npm_config_name" ]; then echo "Missing required --name argument. Example: npm run db:migration:add --name=AddUsers"; exit 1; fi; dotnet ef migrations add "$npm_config_name" --project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj --startup-project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj'
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef database update --project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj --startup-project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj
scripts.db:migrate:to: sh -c 'if [ -z "$npm_config_name" ]; then echo "Missing required --name argument. Example: npm run db:migrate:to --name=InitialCreate (or --name=0 to rollback all)"; exit 1; fi; dotnet ef database update "$npm_config_name" --project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj --startup-project server/ProjectHiddenVillage.Server.csproj'
